result.title: MLAfication: Efficiently Enabling High-Fidelity MLA for Modern LLMs
result.summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compresses the KV cache into a latent representation, reducing inference memory and bandwidth. Existing MHA2MLA/TransMLA methods do not support QKNorm and require costly recovery on modern LLMs, especially MoE. We present MLAfication, a QKNorm-compatible, parameter-efficient extension of MHA2MLA. It combines calibrated KNorm, parameter-efficient distillation, contribution-aware Partial-RoPE, and activation-aware joint KV initialization. Across MHA and GQA models, including QKNorm- and MoE-equipped variants, MLAfication preserves performance under substantial KV-cache compression, surpasses the current SOTA on commonsense and long-context benchmarks, and extends MLA conversion to modern architectures. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MLAfication delivers up to $5.35\times$ the serving throughput of BF16 GQA and, combined with 4-bit KV quantization, reduces the KV-cache footprint by $94.73\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/JT-Ushio/MLAfication.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 MLAfication，将现代 LLM（含 QKNorm 与 MoE 架构）的 MHA/GQA 注意力转换为 MLA，通过校准 KNorm、参数高效蒸馏、贡献感知 Partial-RoPE 与激活感知 KV 初始化，在压缩 KV 缓存的同时保持性能并提升服务吞吐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent」指 KV 缓存压缩的低秩表示，属于纯文本推理效率与架构转换工作，不涉及视觉/多模态推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，也未提供可迁移到 LVR 状态表示或训练监督的具体线索。
